_readme: Named planning scenarios run by 04_npv_engine.py (planning_scenarios()). Each applies several shocks at once, so results include interactions the one-at-a-time tornado cannot show. Shock types as in the tornado: add, mult, mult_list, set. 'ALL' shocks apply to every line that has the assumption. Illustrative definitions (J); in production Finance / FP&A supplies the planning scenarios so the actuarial forecast and the financial plan are stressed the same way. The first scenario must be the base.

scenarios.name: Adverse cost environment
scenarios.description: Trend +1.5 pts all lines; Med Supp rate increases +0.5 pt (partial response); Medicaid rate update +0.5 pt (partial recognition)

scenarios.name: Utilization spike (year-1 level)
scenarios.description: Claim-cost level +4% all years (a one-time step-up carried forward by trend), no rate response

scenarios.name: State rate cut
scenarios.description: Medicaid rate update -1.5 pts and medical cost ratio +1 pt (rates certified below cost)

scenarios.name: Persistency shift
scenarios.description: Lapse x1.25 Med Supp and D&V (competitive market); Medicaid churn x1.2 (redetermination wave)

scenarios.name: Higher rates environment
scenarios.description: Hurdle rate +1 pt and investment earned rate +1 pt (a higher-rate environment moves both)
